title: The Hollow Census
text: The census-takers come back with one more name than there are people in the city. The extra name is written in your House's ledger, in your House's own hand.

options.label: Search the Seat for the one who isn't there.

outcomes.text: Behind a wall that should be solid is a room furnished for someone small. The bed is still warm. You brick it up again.
You find them sitting at table with the recruits. Soon nobody can remember who sat in that chair before.

options.label: Strike the extra name out, hoping it stays struck.

outcomes.text: Each morning the ink comes back. In time you stop checking.
The name stays struck. At dawn a recruit's bed is empty, and nobody can remember their face.

options.label: Claim the name as a child of the House before anyone asks whose it is.

outcomes.text: A name in the ledger is a claim at court, and the court is too frightened to argue.
The name answers when called. Something walks your halls at night in House colors.
